properties.displayName: Storage account should use a private link connection

metadata.displayName: Storage account should use a private link connection
metadata.description: Private links enforce secure communication by providing private connectivity to the storage account.
metadata.remediationDescription: To add a private endpoint connection: 1. Go to the Azure portal. 2. Select Networking. 3. Select Private endpoint connections. 4. Select + Private endpoint.

properties.displayName: Virtual machines should encrypt temp disks, caches, and data flows

status.description: Azure Disk Encryption is not enabled on the virtual machine.

metadata.displayName: Virtual machines should encrypt temp disks, caches, and data flows
metadata.description: By default, a virtual machine's OS and data disks are encrypted at rest using platform-managed keys. Temp disks and data caches aren't encrypted, and data isn't encrypted when flowing between compute and storage resources.
metadata.remediationDescription: To enable disk encryption: 1. Go to the Azure portal. 2. Select the VM. 3. Under Settings, select Disks. 4. Enable encryption.

properties.displayName: SQL servers should have an Azure Active Directory administrator provisioned

status.description: An Azure Active Directory administrator has not been provisioned for this SQL server.

metadata.displayName: SQL servers should have an Azure Active Directory administrator provisioned
metadata.description: Provision an Azure AD administrator for your SQL server to enable Azure AD authentication. Azure AD authentication enables simplified permission management and centralized identity management.
metadata.remediationDescription: To set an Azure AD admin for your SQL server: 1. Go to the Azure portal. 2. Navigate to your SQL server. 3. Under Settings, select Azure Active Directory. 4. Set admin.

properties.displayName: Web Application should only be accessible over HTTPS

metadata.displayName: Web Application should only be accessible over HTTPS
metadata.description: Use of HTTPS ensures server/service authentication and protects data in transit from network layer eavesdropping attacks.
metadata.remediationDescription: To enforce HTTPS: 1. Go to your App Service. 2. Select TLS/SSL settings. 3. Set HTTPS Only to On.

properties.displayName: Key Vault should use a virtual network service endpoint

status.description: Resource does not support virtual network service endpoints.

metadata.displayName: Key Vault should use a virtual network service endpoint
metadata.description: This policy audits any Key Vault not configured to use a virtual network service endpoint.
metadata.remediationDescription: To configure a virtual network service endpoint: 1. Open Key Vault in the portal. 2. Select Networking. 3. Add a virtual network.

properties.displayName: Log Analytics agent should be installed on virtual machines

status.description: The Log Analytics agent is not installed on this resource.

metadata.displayName: Log Analytics agent should be installed on virtual machines
metadata.description: This policy audits any Windows/Linux virtual machines if the Log Analytics agent is not installed.
metadata.remediationDescription: To install the Log Analytics agent: 1. Go to the VM in the Azure portal. 2. Under Settings, select Extensions. 3. Add Log Analytics agent.
